[Current Frontend Spec](README.md)

Frozen v1.0 (`8cdb9219bed9493147ba10f7d47423df56cbcc44`) is the only visual source. These rules connect source, the actual prototype and Master’s R1 decisions. Follow v1.0 for unspecified details instead of inventing a modernized replacement. Content comes first, organized through directories, paragraphs, tables and forms; the resting view is quiet, with local effects during interaction.

## Layout and boundaries

Use the web proportions: normal columns are left 196px, center `minmax(0,1fr)`, right 270px. At ≤1100px use 166px/230px sidebars; collapsed right rail is 48px. At ≤850px it starts collapsed and expands as an overlay without squeezing text. At ≤600px the left rail is 64px with vertical branding. Continuous resizing changes the center, keeping sidebars fixed within each breakpoint.

Both sidebars span the full layout height and are separated by color surfaces, not cards. The selected left row uses the central background and interrupts the matching vertical border, joining the document. Ongoing work, recent artifacts and shortcuts form one right-rail module; unimplemented content remains empty. Structural rules reach their module edges where possible; text uses padding. Avoid inset decorative rules and crossing unrelated columns.

[layout + breakpoints](https://github.com/ExplodeCode6324/secretary-phase-ui-design/blob/8cdb9219bed9493147ba10f7d47423df56cbcc44/style.css#L2221) · [selected row](https://github.com/ExplodeCode6324/secretary-phase-ui-design/blob/8cdb9219bed9493147ba10f7d47423df56cbcc44/style.css#L1997) · [edge rules](https://github.com/ExplodeCode6324/secretary-phase-ui-design/blob/8cdb9219bed9493147ba10f7d47423df56cbcc44/style.css#L2308)

The full-width heading-bottom rule aligns with the Conversation row bottom: shared top height188px,183px at≤600px; toolbar76/64px. This applies at all breakpoints and14–18px text sizes. Non-send errors and reading notices appear below the rule; send status is below the editor. Set application light/dark color-scheme and use the document background for scrollbar tracks.

## Colors and typography

The values below come from v1.0 theme rules. Keep its status selectors and meanings; do not invent status colors after reading only initial tokens. Pair color with text; decorative blue layers do not signal business completion.

| Token / surface | Light | Dark |
| --- | --- | --- |
| document | `#fffcf6` | `#000000` |
| sidebar | `#f5f2ea` | `#141414` |
| `--ink` | `#262b31` | `#e0e4e8` |
| `--muted` | `#686b6e` | `#a1a9b2` |
| `--line` | `#cec9bf` | `#363636` |
| `--blue` | `#285ea6` | `#79acd9` |
| `--light-blue` | `#8bbde0` | `#b1d5ec` |
| `--red` | `#b84550` | `#ed8791` |
| `--green` | `#42715a` | `#92bfa3` |

Master’s 2026-10-22 decision: UI, branding and timestamps use Noto Sans; conversation prose and the editor use Noto Serif. Chinese falls back to Noto Sans SC (the Simplified Chinese Noto Sans CJK member), then PingFang SC, Apple Color Emoji and generic families. Code blocks and inline code retain system monospace. Base size14px, line height1.65. Bundle fonts and OFL licenses offline, with no runtime download: Latin normal/italic and CJK normal variable weights100–900; disable font synthesis. Branding is plain black in light mode and semantic light ink in dark mode, with no colored fringes either statically or during motion and no container. The configured assistant name falls back to `Secretary`; truncated names remain fully accessible. Avatar dimensions and semantics stay unchanged.

## Motion and page sources

Three layers describe display composition: reconstructed base with real gaps, local slices and sparse two-color residues. Three frames are distinct discrete time states. Moved source fragments leave gaps; an intact icon with colored outlines is insufficient. Frame two reverses direction/region; frame three narrows and reduces displacement. States appear at 0%, 26.67%, 53.33%, restoring at 80%. Source geometry, layout and hit areas remain fixed. No full-screen RGB, fake logs, bouncing or general scaling/rotation.

| Object | v1.0 duration |
| --- | --- |
| Icon A / B / C | 160 / 180 / 200 ms |
| Small icon | 140 ms |
| Brand / avatar | 180 ms |
| Send square / arrow | 160 / 420 ms |
| Composer boundary / separator | 140 / 150 ms |

The420ms send-arrow projection remains a specific exception. Master’s2026-10-22 decision: each150ms divider effect reconstructs2/2/3 segments in its three frames, length min(14px, visible line length×0.035), at22%/62%,42%/76%,15%/55%/61%, with down/up, up/down, down/up/down offsets of1.5px. Vertical lines use left/right displacement and avoid the selected-row blank interval. Removed source segments leave real gaps, without colored residue; parameters are centralized. Keep a25% chance per contact,700ms cooldown, one active divider globally, and no background loop.

Conversation uses date rules, avatar/name/time and paragraphs; tasks use tables with inline disclosure; artifacts use filenames with adjacent metadata; memory groups summaries and records; attention separates decisions from authorization; settings use drafts followed by review. Frozen code/images below define concrete construction and storyboards; concept art does not override final code.
